methodology.notes: Custom voice evaluation on all 97 banking_knowledge base tasks, regular speech, alltools retrieval, one trial. Run seed 300; trial 0 seed 626729. Agent openai_live:gpt-live-1 delegates to gpt-6-astra at high effort, with marin voice and priority service. Caller openai/responses/gpt-5.5 uses xhigh effort and ElevenLabs eleven_v3 with native persona voices; full reviewer openai/gpt-5.5. Native error and hallucination retry limits are three; one 15-worker controller. Sierra tau2-bench 1.0.1, base 2174a603f6d014ef94473ffa95957f6ce27100db, with local execution/resource changes; task definitions, policies, prompts and native grading logic unchanged. The entire high run was selected from two complete ElevenLabs candidates (high and xhigh), with no per-task best-of mixing. Includes all 97 canonical histories, combined both.wav recordings, native label files, and original rewards and reviews. Differs from the 2026-09-09 GPT Live custom entry (medium backend effort, default Anthropic hallucination reviewer, 31.96% banking) in backend effort, service tier, and hallucination reviewer; task definitions, seed, voices and personas are identical. Sierra verification: checksums verified; 36/97 recounted; re-graded on main with embedded and fresh task definitions (0 flips); interaction_metrics recomputed (exact match). The run's results.json recorded audio_native_config.live_config.service_tier='priority', a field not in the public tau2-bench LiveConfig schema; it was removed from the hosted results.json so the trajectories load with public tooling, and no other trajectory content was modified.
